title: Original Oven Roasted Dutch Toffee Popcorn Casserole
description: A kid-friendly Dutch dish featuring toffee popcorn with an umami flavor, this casserole is perfect for a snack or dessert. It is made with reduced ingredients and is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the brown sugar to the saucepan and stir until dissolved.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, vanilla extract, salt, and baking powder.
Add the toffee popcorn to the bowl and stir until well combined with the egg mixture.
Pour the sugar and butter mixture over the popcorn mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
